purpose: Repeat one fixed CPU experiment and independently compare discrete outcomes under identical declared conditions.
data: UCI Wine, row IDs are 1-based and excluded from features; use all 13 features.
split: One stratified 75/25 split, seed 42; retain split.json order. Train 133 (44/53/36), test 45 (15/18/12).
method: Train-only StandardScaler and fixed LogisticRegression in a Pipeline; DummyClassifier most_frequent on same train. No tuning, feature selection, or test-driven changes. ConvergenceWarning fails.
runtime: CPython 3.12.15, Linux x86_64, locked seven wheels, four thread limits 1 and verified numerical pools 1. Capture declared fingerprint.
scores: For each classifier use exact Fraction arithmetic then one float conversion for accuracy and mean class recall; retain counts, confusion matrices and row predictions.
comparison: Verify full materials, actual execution artifacts and independently recompute outcomes from raw labels and split; exact equality only with identical materials and mandatory environment. Otherwise incomparable or unchecked.
pilots: Three separate fresh processes and directories on the same committed code, without tuning; retain all attempts.
main: Forbidden until protocol and code are frozen after pilot review. Then first successful execution is reference, two independent clean-directory repeats and one new hash-installed venv execution. Record package source and cache use.
limits: Single split and host: no generalization, cross-machine portability, scalability or novelty claims. Wheels and Python are not bundled.
